title: agent_membership_change notification: E2EE preview MUST be client-redacted

preconditions.comment: Source Flow is E2EE; bridge synthesises an agent_membership_change notification for client-side display, but MUST NOT leak plaintext from the original Move.

payload.comment_for_client: Preview field intentionally null in E2EE flows; client MAY compute a local preview after MLS unwrap.

delivery_invariants: no plaintext leak from MLS-protected Move
preview field is null OR an opaque ciphertext blob
receiver client computes preview locally after MLS unwrap if needed

negative_sub_case.remediation: operator MUST patch bridge; affected events SHOULD be quarantined

expected_outcome.design_note: Privacy invariant in §14: server-side bridge is not inside the MLS ratchet, so it has no plaintext to leak; if it appears to have plaintext, the deployment is mis-configured.
